Bi-spectrum: 2MP 32x optical zoom visible + 384x288 thermal (9.7mm, iFoV 1.8 mRad)
Radiometry: -40 to 550C, accuracy +/-2C (<=150C) / +/-15% (>150C), 10 ROI zones, spot temperature
AI object detection (person, vehicle), BestShot; thermal: temperature, tank level and temperature change detection
Thermal palettes: Whitehot, Blackhot, Rainbow, Rainbow2, Sepia, Red, Iron, Custom
120 dB WDR, SSNR V, DIS, defog
RS-485, alarm I/O, audio in (mic/line) + line out
